tasks.label: Verify auth endpoints
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$body1 = '{\"name\":\"Test User\",\"email\":\"verifyuser@example.com\",\"password\":\"Pass123!\"}'; $r1 = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:3000/api/register' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body1; $body2 = '{\"email\":\"verifyuser@example.com\",\"password\":\"Pass123!\"}'; $r2 = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://localhost:3000/api/login' -Method Post -ContentType 'application/json' -Body $body2; $r1 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10; $r2 | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10"

tasks.label: List Node processes
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'node' -or $_.Name -match 'chrome' } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize"
